run_token_generation_client: run the token generation client to send token IDs to a vLLM server and decode results
tokenize_chat_messages: create a function that tokenizes chat messages using AutoTokenizer apply_chat_template for a given model
decode_token_ids: create a function that decodes token IDs back to text using the model tokenizer
build_httpx_client_for_vllm: build an httpx client configured for the vLLM inference generate endpoint with auth headers
send_generation_request: send a non-streaming POST request with token IDs and sampling params to the vLLM generate endpoint
